description: Sorts one cleaner name found on bookings, as the Get started card's Review your cleaner roster does: action add (adds them to the roster and links their past jobs), not_staff (this name is not one of our cleaners), or link (it is staffId under another spelling; links their past jobs). Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: review_cleaner_roster
title: Sort a cleaner name from bookings
